verdict.rationale: Grok Bot runs unattended on its own persistent cloud computer while your laptop is closed, can rerun saved skills on a schedule, and can trigger routines from events such as GitHub notifications. That is genuine headless automation of its own. However, the runtime probe found no public Grok Bot API, CLI, or MCP endpoint (it is driven only through its apps), so it cannot be invoked from a CI pipeline, and approval prompts and credential handoffs still require a human. Missing for 10: CLI or programmatic API to invoke Bots from CI, non-interactive approval and config for pipelines, documented CI integration, hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
